card.name: Liver and hepat- terms in labels
card.fires_on: The word liver or the start of hepat- words (hepatic, hepatitis, hepatotoxicity), often just after a word like elevated, chronic, anti-, or at the start of a heading.

modes.label: Inside hepat- words
modes.description: Partway through words such as hepatitis, hepatic or hepatotoxicity.

modes.label: The word liver
modes.description: The word liver after an adjective in lab or disease phrases.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward liver-related terms such as liver, hepat-, hepatitis and cirrhosis.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about the liver and is about to continue with a liver-related word.
